I will do this rice plot much like I did before, because cash is not easy for me and I do not like risking money on things I have not seen work well on many nearby fields. I will use the seed I keep and know, and I will put manure where I can because this land is ours and I want it to stay strong. I will depend on the rains, not irrigation, and I will bring in some labor for the heavy work because I am old now and I cannot finish all of it with family hands alone.
